hero.description: Crowi is a Markdown-based wiki application. Simple, powerful, self-hostable — open source software for sharing what your team knows.

items.title: Markdown-first
items.description: Write pages in Markdown. GFM, code blocks, PlantUML, and math notation are all supported out of the box.

items.title: Tree-structured pages
items.description: URL paths are page hierarchies. Organize naturally as `/team/handbook/onboarding`.

items.title: Self-hostable
items.description: Run it on your own infrastructure. Your data, your operations — under your control.

items.title: Extensible
items.description: Swap storage, search, and auth via plugins. S3, Elasticsearch, and OAuth are supported.

cta.title: Get started with Crowi
cta.description: Free to use, free to modify — it's open source.

footer.copyright: Crowi is open source software released under the MIT License.
